forum.title: Can any STM32 microcontroller directly interface with DDR memory such as DDR2/DDR3/DDR4?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

If you mean by the DDR interface in the STM32MPxx series, that’s not available on any STM32 **MCU**s. It’s only available on STM32 **MPU**s.

So the answer is no.
forum.content_text: We are designing an STM32-based SOM and want to know whether STM32H7 controllers support DDR memory, or if DDR support is available only in STM32MP series. Please suggest compatible STM32 controllers and reference designs for DDR interfacing.
forum.author: vijayajangam

scraped_replies.html:
Not PC DDR.
But some STM32 MCUs support external RAM with quad/octo/dual quad spi. Some quad/octo/dual quad spi memories support DDR mode. We use that with a H7.
scraped_replies.author: unsigned_char_array
